newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks ebb from peak in choppy trading.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks ebb from peak in choppy trading.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks backed away from their record closing highs set earlier this week.
The Nasdaq Composite ended off nine to close at 1242 unofficially on volume of about 591 million. Market breadth was weak, with losers beating gainers about 10 to nine.
On Tuesday, the index had hurdled as high as 1258.10.
"We're down pretty hard, but it's not any one group or trend, it's a very choppy environment with a downward bias," said Jack Bayer, head OTC trader at Oppenheimer.
"I don't see any panicking or heavy selling, but there are a lot of momentum players, so we're very sensitive to news announcements," he said.
Software maker TCSI Corp shares dropped about 44 percent, or 5-5/8 to 7-1/4, after it posted a third quarter loss after the market close on Wednesday. Intel Corp, Sun Microsystems both ended lower.
XLConnect Solutions Inc, a provider of networking products, was on fire after its initial public offering. The stock jumped 85 percent to 27-1/4 within its first few minutes of trading.
